newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 26.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
"PENNY OFF TAX' CLAIM AS BUDGET IS LEAKED

The Chancellor Kenneth Clarke will deliver his Budget this afternoon in the wake of the biggest leak of Budget details in British history. Documents containing budget details were leaked to the Daily Mirror, whose editor decided not to publish them, but the Sun then published what it claimed were some of the main points of the budget, including a penny cut in the basic rate of income tax.
800 JOBS TO GO AFTER RECORD LOSS AT UBS

Following Union Bank of Switzerland's record annual loss of 500 million Swiss francs, or 232 million pounds stg, the group has announced a one-off provision of three billion Swiss francs, and its intention to make 800 redundancies in Switzerland.
BUDGET PUZZLES SET TO SHAKE MARKETS

As dealers try to estimate the accuracy of leaked Budget details, gilt and stock markets are set for a day of confusion. One of the reported details, a surprise cut in corporation tax, will, if true, have a positive effect on company finances, dividends and share prices.

600 Lloyd's Names who insisted on better terms at the last minute have been blocked from participation in the 3.2 billion pounds stg rescue plan, putting a resolution of the long-running disputes at risk.
WATER COMPANIES FIND SOURCE OF CASH IN OZ

Thames Water and United Utilities are involved in separate partnerships with other international firms to manage sections of the water supply in South Australia, using it as a base for involvement in Asia, where it is estimated 81 billion pounds stg worth of water infrastructure will be required over the next decade.
DRINKS GIANTS TUNE IN TO TV DESPITE AD BAN THREAT

The U.S. drinks industry's lobbying group, the Distilled Spirits Council, voted to overturn the voluntary ban on spirits advertising on TV and radio after divisions of GrandMet and Canada's Seagram said they would start running ads. They have done so in the face of a warning from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission that it could introduce a total ban on the advertising of liquor and beer.
